ra.description: Trimmed and lower-cased. It is the login (RN-09).

accessibilityNeed.description: Category of what the person needs in class, never a diagnosis (RNF-13). Never null.

birthDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, between 1900-01-01 and today (America/Sao_Paulo). Never null.

classNeeds.description: Needs during class. What the person needs in class, never a diagnosis (RNF-13).
